title: Black Jack Bungalow on 30A's Seacrest Beach | Ocean Reef Resorts
meta_description: Black Jack Bungalow will make you feel like you
description_expanded: Black Jack Bungalow will make you feel like you've hit the jackpot with its stellar amenities, prime location, and refreshed coastal charm. This stylish three-bedroom, pet-friendly vacation home accommodates up to a dozen lucky beachgoers, offering multiple beds, bunks, and two queen-size sleeper sofas. Nestled along Scenic 30A in Seacrest Beach, this retreat is just a short stroll from the sugar-white sands and the mesmerizing jewel-toned Gulf. But why walk when you can cruise? Hop in the complimentary six-seater golf cart or take one of the four beach-cruising bicycles for an effortless ride to paradise. Back at the bungalow, an impressive 30' x 18' lagoon-style private pool—heat optional in cooler months—beckons for a refreshing dip. The sun-drenched patio features plenty of lounge chairs for basking in the Florida sunshine, while an umbrella offers a shady spot to relax. For dining under open skies, the expansive sundeck has been perfectly outfitted with cushioned loungers, rattan egg chairs, and a full outdoor dining table shaded by a large umbrella. Whether you’re sipping morning coffee or enjoying cocktails at sunset, this space is designed for gathering and unwinding. A winding exterior staircase leads up to the crow's nest observation deck, partially shaded by a pergola. High-back Adirondack chairs invite you to sit back and soak in sweeping 360-degree views, including views of the Gulf and vibrant sunsets that paint the horizon in brilliant hues. Inside, a crisp, coastal-chic vibe welcomes you with vaulted white-beamed ceilings, glowing natural light, and thoughtful design details. The open-concept living, dining, and kitchen area has been completely updated, blending airy sophistication with warm accents. The living space centers around a striking stone fireplace (decorative only) and wall-mounted flatscreen TV, with plush sectional seating, accent chairs, and colorful textures that make it both stylish and inviting. A bright neon sign nodding to the home’s name adds a playful coastal touch. The adjacent dining area features a rustic wood table paired with woven chairs beneath a wicker pendant light, while the kitchen shines with sleek white cabinetry, brushed stainless steel appliances, and clean countertops for effortless meal prep. Just beyond, a cheerful sunroom wrapped in windows creates an additional lounging retreat. Here, guests can relax with casual seating, enjoy a book, or step directly out onto the spacious deck for outdoor dining beneath the stars. Each bedroom is uniquely designed with a fresh personality. The primary suite is a serene retreat, featuring a king-size bed, private balcony access, and a beautifully updated ensuite bath with a marble walk-in shower. A second guest room pairs comfort and color with a plush king-size bed framed by soft pastels and beach-inspired artwork, while a third bunk room ensures plenty of fun with two sets of bunks, vibrant décor, an arcade machine, and bold surfboard-patterned wallpaper. Each space blends comfort and creativity, making the home perfect for families or groups. Beyond the bungalow’s luxe amenities, its location is unbeatable. Seacrest Beach is just minutes from two rare coastal dune lakes—Camp Creek Lake and Deer Lake—natural wonders found in only a few places worldwide. These lakes create a mesmerizing mix of fresh and saltwater ecosystems, attracting abundant wildlife and offering excellent paddleboarding, kayaking, and fishing opportunities. For even more adventure, the charming Village of Rosemary Beach is just around the corner. This picturesque destination, inspired by Dutch West Indies architecture, is brimming with fine dining restaurants, quaint bistros, art galleries, and boutique shopping. Year-round events, including outdoor concerts, art festivals, seasonal fireworks, and old-fashioned lawn games, make it a vibrant hub of activity. With its unbeatable combination of luxury, location, and playful upgrades, Black Jack Bungalow is the ultimate beach getaway. Don’t wait—lock in your stay before someone else hits the jackpot! First Floor: Bunk Room with Two Twin Bunks, Hall Bath with Tub/Shower Combo, Covered Parking. Second Floor: Living Room with Queen Sleeper Sofa, Kitchen, Dining, King Bedroom with Walk-In Shower and Balcony Access, Queen Bedroom, Hall Bath with Tub/Shower Combo, Sun Room with Queen Sleeper Sofa and Balcony Access, Laundry, Exterior Staircase. Third Floor: Crows Nest with Seating and Gulf Views. *Add $50.00 per day to heat pool (available Oct-April if needed)
